featured_reviews.name: KB Roy
featured_reviews.review_text:
A South Indian Hindu temple/Ayyappa shrine on the serene hillside of Shreenagar/ Shantinagar at Wagle Estate, Thane. During the early 1970s, a few devotees of swamy Ayyappan joined together for prayers and from there the movement started growing until 1977 when the Samiti was registered as a trust and thereafter it continued to spread, grow and attract adherents.

Lots of steps to get to the very top as the temple is located on a slope, Once on top one can get excellent views of some areas of Mumbai which is both beautiful and pleasing. Many people use the open area on top for Yoga, massage therapy or martial arts. The garden seems to be well maintained by the temple. The area appeared clean and many people came in to offer prayers during the time I was there. The temple opens early morning at 5am and closes at 9pm.

featured_reviews.name: Kruti Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: "The experience is completely different from the outside. Once you enter the temple, there is a black stone structure that makes you feel like you are in South India. We had Sunday prashadam served on a banana leaf, and it was very tasty.”

featured_reviews.name: Madhavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sri Ayyappa Swamy Temple in Sai Baba Nagar, Borivali West, is a शांत और पवित्र place that offers a deeply spiritual experience. The temple is well maintained and has a calm, positive atmosphere that helps devotees feel peaceful as soon as they enter. The Ayyappa Swamy idol is beautifully adorned, and the daily poojas and bhajans are conducted with great devotion and discipline. During special occasions like Mandala Pooja and Makara Sankranti, the temple becomes especially vibrant while still remaining well organized. The priests and volunteers are polite and helpful, making devotees feel welcome.

Overall, it is a wonderful place for prayer, meditation, and finding inner peace, especially for Ayyappa devotees and residents nearby.

featured_reviews.name: Harshala Mirkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
This was a truly awful experience. I went to them specifically for a *custom* devara. They have a bunch of ready-made designs, but I needed something specific, which is why I asked for customization in the first place.  If I had just wanted something generic, I would have bought one of their pre-made ones!  I gave them a picture of exactly what I wanted it to look like.  What they made was completely different. It barely resembled the picture I gave them.  The owner then tried to tell me I had never actually told him what I wanted, which is a complete lie because I had given him a picture!  I had to argue with him, pointing out all the ways it was wrong.  Not only was the overall design wrong, but they also added extra details that I had specifically said I didn't want.  And through it all, the owner was trying to sweet-talk me, like that would make up for the mess they made.  It felt like he was trying to make me feel like I was being unreasonable, when all I wanted was what I had originally asked for – a *custom* piece that matched the picture *I provided*.

After a lot of back and forth and me refusing to take the incorrect devara, the owner finally said he would make the changes to match my picture.  I was hopeful, but even after they supposedly "fixed" it, it *still* wasn't right.  It wasn't even better. It was just adifferent* wrong.  It was still far from what I had asked for. When I pointed this out again, the owner started making excuses. He claimed that the wood in my picture was different from the wood they use, and that's why they couldn't make it look the same.  This was incredibly frustrating because he never mentioned anything about this before I placed the order.  He only brought it up *after* he messed up the design.  It felt like he was just trying to find a way out of admitting his mistake.

I had to keep arguing with him, explaining over and over what was wrong and how it didn't match my picture.  He kept trying to convince me to buy it anyway, even though it wasn't what I wanted.  The whole process was incredibly stressful and time-consuming.  I felt like they didn't care at all about what I wanted.  They just wanted to get rid of the devara they had made, even though it was wrong.  Eventually, I was so tired of arguing and dealing with the situation that I reluctantly bought the devara, even though it wasn't what I had envisioned.  I just wanted the whole thing to be over.  I am extremely disappointed with their service and would absolutely not recommend them to anyone.  They don't listen to their customers, they make excuses for their mistakes, they try to pressure you into buying things you don't want, and they try to sell it to you with their sweet talk.
